book.title: LOMA MeLoma ꞌidi leta Paulo ꞌileleya

content: Ceguma gide, toꞌaha hede ꞌana bwebweꞌana tauda sigwaegwaenegita sigwaeya meYudiya? Ma wetenuge toꞌaha Ebalahamo ꞌina ꞌilaꞌilalaina ꞌana bwebweꞌana wahida siꞌupwaꞌupwa?
Ta ginaula bwebweꞌadi baibaiwadi ꞌoida simiyamiya. Ma ginaula nugenugetaina beno Yehoba ꞌina gwae ꞌoida ꞌilaguyama.
Ma togidega, ꞌeguma tupwadi Yehoba siguipaileya, wanuwatuhuya ꞌabehega Yehoba wete nata ꞌiguipailegita, bo geya?
Nata geya! Weyahina bwagana tauda mabwaiyada toꞌeꞌaboꞌabo, ma Yehoba tuwa ꞌiboimo dumwadumwaluna. Yehoba tauna weyahina ꞌina Buki gide ꞌihepwaila ꞌesa, ꞌigwaeya

content.text: Cabehega ꞌina gwaeyega siꞌahwamoisae, ma ꞌina yatala ꞌoina ꞌihewaiwai.

content: Ma ꞌeguma ꞌida mumuga galana ꞌoinega Yehoba mumugana bwebweꞌana ꞌimasaleha bwaibwaina, toꞌaha nata tagwaene? Bo nata tagwae, “Yehoba yo, ꞌima mumuga galana weyahina sahena ꞌuloiloinaemai.” Moisa bewa yahegwaegwae besobeso tuwa gide tupwadi tomota sigwaegwae ꞌesa.
Ma wanuwatuhuyahi ꞌabehega Yehoba tauna toloina dumwadumwaluna, ꞌoinega bwaꞌomatana ꞌana tuta ꞌoina nata ꞌina loina dumwadumwalunega mabwaiyada ꞌiloinaegita.

Coinega tupwadi toꞌeꞌaboꞌabo sigwaegwaenegau, sigwaeya, “Cino loguguya ꞌoina ꞌugwaeya ꞌabehega ꞌigu ꞌabo ꞌoinega Yehoba mumugana dumwadumwaluna ꞌiꞌabihelatuya tomota ꞌoidiya ta Yehoba sihepwatuweya, ta nata Yehoba geya sowana ꞌiꞌahwaꞌahwa galagalaegau. Coinega ꞌilobwainemaiya tauma wete ꞌapaihowa galagala, ma ꞌane ginaula bwebweꞌadi silatu.” Taudi tomotaedi gwaenigu sigwaegwaene ꞌilobwainediya Yehoba ꞌiloinaedi.
Geya ꞌeta taiya mumugana bwebweꞌana
Ma togidega tauda meYudiya ꞌida miya ꞌibwebweꞌana hedadeya, ta taudi tomiya ganamuli ꞌidi miya geya bwebweꞌana? Geya! Weyahina yaheꞌita pwaigita ꞌabehega mabwaiyada topui.
Gide Yehoba ꞌina Buki ꞌihepwaila, ꞌigwaeya,

content.text: Ma geya ꞌeta wete taiya Yehoba ꞌisanapu, bo nuwanuwana ma ꞌida sanapu. Tuwa geya uleulena!
Moisa tuwa, tomota mabwaiyadi sitauya puiya, ta pui ꞌana ꞌeda ꞌoina silatuwa. Geya ꞌeta wete taiya ꞌina paihowa bwebweꞌana.
Cahwadi gide galiha soꞌesoꞌena, ma ꞌoinega ꞌeꞌaboꞌabowedi galadiyedi silatulatuma, Ma wete ꞌidi gwaeyao galadi gide mwata, nuwanuwadi ꞌoidiyega tomota silohe ꞌamasidi.
Ma tuta mabwaiyana heliya galadi ꞌahwadiyega silatulatu.
Ma heꞌupwa ta loheꞌamasa nuwadi ꞌiꞌeweya.
Ma to tupwa ꞌoina sihaꞌesa ꞌidi ꞌabihegala leleyana ꞌimiyamiya.
Geya ꞌeta nuwadaumwala bo heꞌahwaꞌiyaꞌiyagu sisanapu.
Ma wete geya Yehoba ꞌana matauta ꞌoidiya ꞌimiyamiya.”

content: Ma tasanapu pwaiya ꞌabehega Mosese ꞌina loinao beno meYudiya ꞌada loina ꞌoinega geya sowana ꞌeta taiya ꞌigwaegwae hila tutaina Yehoba ꞌina bwaꞌomatana ꞌana tuta ꞌoina, weyahina tomiya baleꞌu mabwaiyada togala.
Yehoba ꞌina ꞌahwamoisa geya Mosese ꞌina loina ꞌana guibiga ꞌoinega tada lobeya, weyahina loina ꞌina paihowa beno ꞌida pui ꞌihehepwailedi.
Ceguma Yesu tahemise Yehoba ꞌiꞌahwa bwebweꞌanegita
Coinega bewa tuta Yehoba ꞌada ꞌahwabwebweꞌana ꞌiꞌabihelatuya, ꞌabehega geya loina ꞌoinega, ma hali ꞌedaꞌeda ꞌoinega hesiyage. Ma ꞌedaꞌedainaina Mosese ꞌina loina ta palopitao sihepwaila pwaiya,
ꞌabehega Yehoba mabwaiyada ꞌiꞌahwa dumwaluwegita Yesu Keliso ꞌana hemisa ꞌoinega, ma geya sowana ꞌeta taiya wete wataha ꞌiꞌabiꞌabihelatu tauda meYudiya ma tomiya ganamuli gamwagamwanida.
Weyahina mabwaiyada togala, ma tamiya bwagabwaga Yehoba ꞌina ꞌasilala ꞌoinega.
Ma hesi Yehoba ꞌina ꞌatemuyamuya ma ꞌihelauwa ꞌoida, ta Yesu Keliso ꞌina paihowega ꞌilihasigita ꞌida pui ꞌoidiyega, ma ꞌoinega Yehoba ꞌiꞌahwa dumwaluwegita.

Moisa tuwa, Yehoba natuna ꞌitagwaleya ma ꞌabehega ꞌina ꞌamasega ꞌitoehilegita Yehoba ꞌoina, ma mahetedai taheꞌiyaꞌiyagu, beno ꞌeguma Yesu tahemisae. Bewa ꞌoinega Yehoba mumugana bwebweꞌana ꞌiheꞌitegita, weyahina mwalo heneyage mumugada galana geya ꞌida hemaisediya, ma tuwa ꞌiꞌalamaꞌiꞌitana ꞌana siga Yesu Keliso ꞌihewasaeyama, ꞌisuluma ꞌoida.
Eeta tuta bewa ꞌina mumuga bwebweꞌana ꞌiheꞌitegita ꞌabehega tauna todumwalu, weyahina Yesu ꞌana tohemisao tauda ꞌiꞌahwa bwebweꞌanegita.
Ma togidega, sowasowahida bewa ginaulina weyahina tagwae hanehane? Geya! Weyahina ꞌida hemisa tuwa ꞌoinega ꞌiꞌahwaꞌahwa dumwaluwegita, ma geya loina ꞌana hematamatana ꞌoinega.
Eeta nuwatuhu bewama ꞌana lohegogona ꞌabehega tauda tomota ꞌida hemisega Yehoba nata ꞌiꞌahwa bwebweꞌanegita, ma geya loina ꞌana hematamatana ꞌoinega.

Bo hedeyage Yehoba tauda meYudiyamo ꞌida Yehoba, ma hali ꞌasa geya? Geya taboi damo! Casa mabwaiyadi mahetedao ꞌida Yehoba ꞌaigeda tuwa. Yehoba nata tauda meYudiya ma tomiya ganamuli wete ꞌiꞌahwa dumwaluwegita ꞌida hemisega.
Coinega togidega bewama ꞌana sanapu, loinaina ꞌabehega tabuiyahule ta hemisa tada ꞌabiyahi, ꞌawa? Sahena! Ma hesi sawasawahina loina taheꞌasisiye ma ꞌoida ꞌihemadou.
